steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.env.setTime(13); const R=g.racer; const c=Math.cos(R.yaw), s=Math.sin(R.yaw); const lx=-3.2, lz=1.2; const x=R.pos.x+lx*c+lz*s, z=R.pos.z-lx*s+lz*c; g.player.place(x, z, Math.atan2(-(R.pos.x-x), -(R.pos.z-z))); g.player.pitch=-0.25; return 'at the tarp '+x.toFixed(1)+','+z.toFixed(1)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; __rhf.hold('gas', false); const r=g.world.roads.find(r=>r.id==='tundra'); const p=r.path.sample(r.path.length*0.62); g.racer.place(p.x,p.z,Math.atan2(p.tx,p.tz)); return 'on the road'})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; return 'speed '+(g.racer.speed*3.6).toFixed(0)+' km/h gear '+g.racer.gear+' rpm '+g.racer.rpm.toFixed(0)+' drs '+g.racer.drs.toFixed(2)})()
